claim: P96 GATE: compliance_introduced == 0 on all three formats. docx 2311/2311 and pptx 715/715 clean after the last OPC writer fix; xlsx was already clean at P94. Every remaining non-pass across the three corpora is a deliberately corrupt fixture, and each one now has a named cause on record.

closed_in_p96.symptom: part_name_case_unique: output shipped WORD/_rels/DOCUMENT.XML.rels alongside word/_rels/document.xml.rels (libreoffice/casing.docx).
closed_in_p96.root_cause: The source ships word/document.xml and WORD/DOCUMENT.XML as separate ZIP entries. The rels item resolves case-insensitively, so both parts hold the same relationships; serializing both emitted a second rels item that is the same OPC part name as the first.
closed_in_p96.fix: Rels items absent from the source ZIP entry order are dropped when they case-duplicate one already written. A package that genuinely shipped both is written back unchanged.
closed_in_p96.verification: casing.docx open->save now adds zero entries; docx compliance_introduced 1 -> 0.

open_items.symptom: preserve known_xml_minimal_diff fails on ppt/slideMasters/slideMaster2.xml: the 11 <p:sldLayoutId> children are dropped, leaving <p:sldLayoutIdLst/>.
open_items.root_cause: The master's rels point at slideLayout12..22, none of which exist in the package — it only ships slideLayout7 and slideLayout8. The ids are dropped because their relationships are dangling.
open_items.verdict: Accepted, not a defect. The source is a fuzzed LibreOffice bug fixture; PowerPoint repairs it the same way. Recorded so it is never re-triaged from scratch.

open_items.symptom: sample29.xlsx: 'ARIMA Module' has no worksheet part (empty r:id). Typed error on save.
open_items.note: Decide whether a placeholder sheet should be skipped rather than raising.

open_items.symptom: 22 docx + 5 pptx + 5 xlsx open failures. Triaged at P95: non-ZIP, missing [Content_Types].xml, malformed main-part XML, and legacy OLE2 .xls content. All are deliberately corrupt bug-repro fixtures.
open_items.note: phpoffice/SamplePassword.pptx is the only one with a plausible future path — ooxml-core ships opc/crypto.py, so an encrypted package could be opened with a password instead of reported as non-ZIP.

next_gate: P97 is no longer about the compliance stage — all three formats are clean. The next unmeasured surface is rule coverage itself: 27 rules is what the registry happens to contain, not what the corpus needs. Candidate work is a mutation check — inject a known defect class into a healthy package and confirm some rule fires — so 'compliance_introduced == 0' means the instrument looked rather than that it was blind.
notes: Compliance counts only findings absent from the source package. Fixes landed this cycle, all in ooxml-core: eec69a3 (case-insensitive rel target resolution), 103d288 (content-types declaration outranks the backup-suffix filter), c411327 (no invented case-duplicate rels item). Downstream suites green: ooxml-core 1647, python-docx 3634, python-pptx 4051.
